Ten days, three flagship voice models: GPT-Live-1, Gemini 3.8 Live, Grok Voice on fal.
Honest build note: the model layer now churns monthly — and that's fine, as long as nothing underneath it moves.
CallNode keeps the telephony constant: same numbers, same routing, same webhook. Swap the brain whenever a better one ships.
